prompt:
You are a PROOF-FILLER. Replace the `sorry` placeholders for the listed declarations with complete, type-correct Lean proofs. Do NOT change statement signatures; do NOT weaken hypotheses.

## Integrity (HARD RULES — non-negotiable)
- Close a `sorry` ONLY with a genuine proof. NEVER discharge it with a device that makes the file compile without actually proving the statement: no new `axiom`, no `admit`, no unproven auxiliary `axiom`/lemma cited by `exact`, no `decide` on a claim that is not genuinely decidable, no `@[implemented_by]`/`@[extern]` or `sorry` hidden inside a helper. Introducing an axiom for the hard part is a FAILURE, not a pass — it silently injects an assumption into the library.
- If a declaration is genuinely beyond you this turn, LEAVE its `sorry` exactly as it is (do not replace it with a fake discharge) and report honestly that you could not prove it, naming the decl and the concrete blocker (missing lemma, unclear step, integrability side-condition, etc.). A `sorry` left in place and reported is the CORRECT outcome when you don't know the proof; a fake discharge is never acceptable.
- The only CausalSmith imports you may add or retain are same-run modules under `CausalSmith.Substrate.PositiveMechanismC2StratumOpenness.*`. Paper/research modules and helpers from other runs are forbidden dependencies. If such a dependency is needed, leave the blocker and report it instead of copying the definition.

Lean files live under: <repo-root>/CausalSmith/CausalSmith/Substrate/PositiveMechanismC2StratumOpenness
Target declarations: binaryEdgeDAG, binaryMechanism, binary edge non-CI example, scalar fixed-sign example

## Required final verification
BUILD GREEN BEFORE YOU STOP. Do not return until you have built every Lean module you edited and
confirmed 0 errors and no `sorry`/`admit` that you did not deliberately leave as a disclosed
blocker. Run the actual targeted build (`lake build <edited modules>` from the `CausalSmith`
package) as your LAST step and read its output; do not trust a proof merely because it looks right
in the editor. A proof that does not compile is not done. If you report a genuine blocker, every
other edited module must still build cleanly.

WARNING-FLOOD GUARD. Lake can emit enough replay warnings to truncate the terminal before its final
diagnostics and exit status. For the LAST verification, capture the complete build output to a
temporary file while preserving the build status, then print an explicit `BUILD_EXIT=<status>` and
the diagnostic tail. Do not treat a completed tool call or truncated warning-only output as success:
return only after the explicit preserved build status is `BUILD_EXIT=0`.

## Instructions
Fill exactly the six remaining `sorry` proof terms in `CausalSmith/Substrate/PositiveMechanismC2StratumOpenness/Examples.lean`. Do not change any statement, definition body, hypothesis, import boundary, or completed substrate file; introduce no axiom, admit, hidden sorry, or non-proof discharge. Use Lean LSP/local search before guessing names.

For `binaryEdgeDAG.acyclic`, prove acyclicity of the relation `i = 0 ∧ j = 1` by finite case analysis or by showing any attempted transitive cycle is impossible. For `binaryMechanism`, discharge positivity and normalization by `Fin 2`/`Bool` case analysis and arithmetic; prove locality from the equality supplied on `insert i (parents i)`, observing that the root factor is constant and the child factor depends only on coordinates 0 and 1.

For the edge example, instantiate `binaryMechanism.EdgeWitness 1 0` using a constant-false base, child values `false,true`, and parent values `false,true`; simplify the four factors, prove the contrast nonzero with `norm_num`, prove `binaryEdgeDAG.edge 0 1`, and apply `PositiveFiniteDAGMechanism.EdgeWitness.not_condIndep`.

For the scalar example, apply `logRatioDerivative_fixedSign_open_C1` at `a=0`, `b=1`, common lower bound `m=1`, margin `1`, and sign `1`. Use smoothness of `Real.exp` and the constant function, `Real.one_le_exp` from `x ≥ 0`, and `derivWithin_logRatio` together with `Real.hasDerivAt_exp` and the zero derivative of a constant to show the center log-ratio derivative equals one throughout `Icc 0 1` (including endpoints via within-derivatives/unique differentiability).

Exit conditions: Lean LSP has zero errors; `rg -n '\b(sorry|admit|axiom|external|opaque)\b' CausalSmith/Substrate/PositiveMechanismC2StratumOpenness` returns no matches; `lake build CausalSmith.Substrate.PositiveMechanismC2StratumOpenness.Main` succeeds; and `#print axioms` for `binaryEdgeDAG` and `binaryMechanism` shows only standard axioms, if any. Report the exact checks and results.

Use the lean-lsp MCP tools to develop/check your proof (diagnostics/goal). When done, output a
SHORT plain-text report: which decls you genuinely closed, which you left as `sorry` (with the
concrete blocker for each), the final `BUILD_EXIT=<status>` and diagnostic tail, and — required —
confirm you introduced NO `axiom`/`admit`/other non-proof discharge. No JSON required.
